notice: Generated by `go test ./internal/composition/ -run TestReadyReasonTableIsCurrent` in go/composition-dynamic-controller, with UPDATE_READY_REASONS=1 to rewrite it, from the same registry as docs/ready-reasons.md. Do not edit by hand. There is one entry per condition, status and reason: look a composition's condition up by those three. Where two writers write the same condition, status and reason (the markdown has a row for each), the entry lists both under writers and gives each one's meaning, clearance, sinceVersion, action and detail fields under cases. The writer cannot be determined from the object, so present the entry's own clearance and action, which are those of its longest-lasting case (indefinite, then timer, then next pass, then steady), and show the condition's message only as detail. Renaming or removing a reason, or changing its status, is a breaking change for consumers: it is done only by listing the old reason under deprecated, with the release it was removed in, and a test refuses any other removal. The set is closed except one entry: on ApiResolved with status False, reason is null and reasonFrom is "authn", because authn's own refusal reasons are passed through as authn sends them; fall back to that entry only for that condition and status, and only when no listed reason matches. verdict is how a parent composition's rollup reads a child carrying the reason: healthy, converging, failed or unevaluated, and null on a condition the rollup does not read (only Ready is read); an unevaluated entry also carries rollsUpAs, the verdict it counts as. clearance.kind is one of four: steady (an end state, not expected to clear), timer (clears when an operation returns, bounded by a named timer), next pass (clears on the next reconcile once its cause is gone) or indefinite (lasts until something outside the controller changes); clearance.detail says what clears it, with any bound in words. sinceVersion is the first core-provider release whose source (with its pinned runtime) contains the reason, a lower bound for a reason string another condition used first; "unreleased" until a release ships it. action is what a person does, naming who (you, an admin, or the blueprint's maintainers) unless it is a wait; it is shown on screen, so changing it is a UI change. detailFields are the status fields carrying the reason's detail beyond the condition's message. Refuse a schemaVersion you do not know.
